validatorSnapshot.notes: Initial Interchain validators are manually selected in genesisValidatorManifest. Public destination BLS proofs are automatically checked; no PoS snapshot required

reserve.notes: XGRChain initial ValidatorRegistry V3 policy (2026-10-24): mainnet eth_gasPrice = 1000000000000 wei; existing generic bootstrap policy budgets 750000 gas (0.75 XGR) minimum, 500000 gas (0.5 XGR) max exit-executor reimbursement, 1000000 gas (1 XGR) per validator. Exactly three pinned validators = 3 XGR constructor reserve, plus wallet gas. Network gas prices may change; immutable wei amounts are checked in MetaMask before signing.

sourceFee.notes: XGRChain initial positive validator source fee: 100 gas-price units at the recorded 1000000000000 wei/gas = 100000000000000 wei (0.0001 XGR) per source operation. Nominal launch fee, not relayer gas coverage. Immutable initial Factory constructor/SourceRegistry nonce 0; later changes require source-chain BLS quorum.

notes: Native compressed BLS precompile requires positive and negative verification vectors; no Solidity verifier deployment. Compressed possession proofs must match the native verifier.
